subject: Hospitality
title: RevPAR: The King of Hotel Metrics
description: A short lesson to help you apply RevPAR: The King of Hotel Metrics.

hook.text: RevPAR—Revenue Per Available Room—is the single most important metric in hotel performance. Everyone watches it.

buildup.text: RevPAR = Average Daily Rate × Occupancy. A hotel with $200 ADR and 80% occupancy has a RevPAR of $160.

discovery.text: RevPAR captures both pricing power and demand. High rates with low occupancy or low rates with full rooms both produce poor.

twist.text: RevPAR ignores costs. A hotel can have great RevPAR and still lose money if operating costs are too high.

climax.text: Investors, analysts, and brands all benchmark hotels by RevPAR. It's the universal language of hotel performance worldwide.

punchline.text: Rate times occupancy. One number tells the hotel's revenue story.

quiz.question: How is RevPAR calculated?
options: Total revenue divided by staff count
Average Daily Rate multiplied by Occupancy percentage
